question_text: Describe how an external backup drive kept at a separate site can reduce the consequences of a fire destroying a workstation.
adaptation_rationale: Retains secondary-storage use-case reasoning; assesses external-storage context rather than an unsupported stand alone disaster-recovery syllabus topic.
solution: A copy of important files is stored on the external drive at the other site.; The fire at the workstation site is unlikely to destroy that separate copy, which can be used for recovery.
